assumptions.statement: The admitted current solve remains on one fixed-topology fixed-rank smooth stratum.
J0 retained state geometry mobility and X_read are frozen at the pre-read stage during the algebraic current solve.

The initial A and C normalized current-to-current profiles use nonnegative dimensionless gains bounded by candidate-specific zeta_bar strictly below one; physical unit compatibility of shared use in the j outer j geometry term remains under the transitive D4 units audit.
A retains the D5 q_A domain with W_hat strictly positive and W_A nonnegative and the D4 baseline has zero current support on exact-zero mobility edges.
C is evaluated only with regular positive Hodge data a valid orientation-covariant isometric I_4M and strictly positive transport mobility on its admitted live-edge components.
The C closure remains parameterized by h_M and does not assume that the missing T_C to H_M to h_M map has been derived.
The D6 read contribution is internal current on the declared graph current space and any open-boundary transport remains explicitly accounted in a named J0 boundary component.
A and parameterized C use the exact linear D5 operators with all noncurrent context frozen; no future nonlinear or joint geometry closure inherits their global uniqueness result.

The initial profile retains one shared nonnegative zeta_a for current and staged j outer j geometry coupling under a normalized V4 profile; a split coefficient profile requires a successor and the physical cross-term units remain open.
Lagged geometry is a revision-distinct GRC9V4 discrete-beat constitutive choice and not a theorem that the core simultaneous active-current loop generally reduces to I minus zeta R.
